content: We need number of aromatic carbons in the sample's molecule. We have no SMILES given. We need to get data via NMR? Possibly we need to infer aromatic carbons from 13C NMR spectrum. Use carbon_nmr_spectra tool to get 13C NMR. Then count aromatic carbon signals (typically 120-150 ppm). Could also use retrieve_carbon_shifts to know ranges. So steps: get carbon NMR. Then parse peaks. Count those within aromatic range (approx 110-160). Use tool. Let's call carbon_nmr_spectra.
